common.serverDown: Awaaz se connect nahi ho paya. Server shuru ho raha hai, ek minute lag sakta hai.
common.couldNotSave: Save nahi ho paya. Phir se koshish karein.

login.headline: Un logo ke liye phone calls jo sun ya bol nahi sakte.
login.subhead: Aap type karein aur Awaaz aapki jagah bolega. Samne wale ki baat screen par likhi aayegi, daam aur time ke sath.
login.footnote: Har call ke shuru mein Awaaz samne wale ko batata hai ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai.
login.signInHint: Calls karne aur uthane ke liye sign in karein.
login.createHint: Bas ek minute lagega. Iske baad aap chunein ki aap kaise baat karna aur sunna chahte hain.
login.devUser: Dev user ki tarah aage badhein (local only)
login.accountCreated: Account ban gaya. Email par aaya link dekhein aur confirm karne ke baad sign in karein.
login.resetSent: Agar is email par account hai, toh humne password reset karne ka link bhej diya hai.
login.typeEmailFirst: Pehle upar apna email likhein, phir “Password bhool gaye?” par tap karein.

authErrors.notConfirmed: Pehle apna email confirm karein. Email inbox mein link dekhein.
authErrors.exists: Is email par pehle se account hai. Sign in karne ki koshish karein.
authErrors.shortPassword: Kam se kam 6 aksharon ka password istemal karein.
authErrors.tooMany: Bohot baar koshish ki gayi. Kuch minute ruk kar phir se try karein.
authErrors.badEmail: Yeh email address sahi nahi lag raha.
authErrors.googleOff: Google sign-in abhi chalu nahi hai.
authErrors.generic: Kuch galti ho gayi. Phir se koshish karein.

onboarding.languageHint: Awaaz har jagah iska istemal karega, captions mein bhi. Aap ise kabhi bhi badal sakte hain.
onboarding.title: Aaiye aapke calls set up karein
onboarding.hint: Do chhote sawal. Aap baad mein Main section mein sab badal sakte hain.
onboarding.nameLabel: Hum aapko kis naam se pukarein?
onboarding.nameHint: Har call ke shuru mein samne wale ko yeh naam bataya jata hai.
onboarding.howPhone: Aap phone kaise istemal karte hain?
onboarding.fineTuneHint: Koi bhi tarika chunein. Baat karne ka pehla tarika call par default rahega.

home.title: Calls
home.noCallsBody: Call shuru karein, ya niche practice call karke dekhein ki captions aur jawab kaise kaam karte hain.
home.practiceHint: Nakli caller, koi asli phone call nahi
home.newCallHint: Jise call karna hai uska number daalein. Awaaz unhe batayega ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyBody: Jin logo ya jagahon ko aap baar-baar call karte hain unhe save karein. Note likhein, jaise “meri BP ki dawai Telma 40 hai”, aur Awaaz ise jawab mein use kar sakta hai.
contacts.sheetHint: Jawab sujhane ke liye Awaaz in notes ka istemal kar sakta hai.
contacts.name: Naam
contacts.notesPlaceholder: Jaise: meri BP ki dawai Telma 40 hai
contacts.saveFailed: Save nahi hua. Phone number check karein.
contacts.deleteBody: Isse contact aur uske notes hat jayenge. Purani calls history mein rahengi.

me.title: Main
me.nameHint: Har call ke shuru mein samne wale ko bataya jata hai.
me.phrasesHint: Call par turant kehne ke liye choti baatein

profile.startFromHint: Yeh bas shuruaat ke liye hai. Aap niche kuch bhi badal sakte hain.
profile.howTalkHint: Jo bhi aap use karte hain sabhi chunein. Pehla tarika aapka default rahega.
profile.howHearHint: Apne hisab se chunein, jaise captions aur saaf awaaz ek saath.
profile.disclosure: Samne wale ko batayein ki ek assistant madad kar raha hai

presets.deafspeak: Sun nahi sakta, par bol sakta hoon
presets.deaftype: Sun nahi sakta, type karna pasand hai

voice.title: Meri apni awaaz
voice.hint: Main bolta hoon, woh seedhe sunte hain.

replies.title: Khas vaakya aur turant jawab
replies.hint: Ek baar daba kar jawab dein.

help.title: Bolne mein madad
help.hint: Thode shabd likhein, saaf poora sentence banega. Pehle aap dekh lein.

clarity.title: Meri awaaz saaf karein
clarity.hint: Main bolunga, Awaaz ise saaf karke dohraayega.

sign.title: Ishaaron ki bhasha (ISL)
sign.hint: Video par ISL interpreter se judein.

captions.title: Saath-saath likha hua
captions.hint: Bade akshar, number alag se dikhenge.

clear.title: Saaf awaaz
clear.hint: Har sentence dheere aur tez awaaz mein dohraya jayega.

audio.title: Normal awaaz
audio.hint: Seedhe awaaz aaye, saaf sunne ke liye thodi tez.

summary.title: Baat ke baad ki summary
summary.hint: Kya baat hui, voice note ki tarah sunen.

vibe.title: Vibration ki ginti
vibe.hint: Jab woh bolna shuru ya band karein, phone vibrate hoga.

translate.title: Mere liye translate karein
translate.hint: Woh chahe kisi bhi bhasha mein bolen, aap apni bhasha mein padhein aur likhein.

phrases.title: Mere khas vaakya
phrases.emptyBody: Jab tak aap apna vaakya nahi jodte, call screen par pehle se bane vaakya dikhenge.

history.nothingSaid: Is call par koi baat nahi hui.
history.loadFailed: Yeh call load nahi ho payi.

call.reconnecting: Phir se connect ho raha hai…
call.draftTitle: Aapke liye banaya gaya. Bole jane se pehle check kar lein
call.draftUnclear: Aapke shabd thode ulajhe hue the. Check karein ki kya yeh wahi keh raha hai jo aap chahte hain.
call.previewTitle: Bole jane se pehle check karein
call.helpPlaceholder: Thode shabd likhein, main sentence bana dunga
call.phrasesHint: Bolne ke liye ek par tap karein.
call.keypadHint: Phone menu ke liye number dabayein, jaise “1 dabayein…”.

blocked.scam_digits: Bheja nahi gaya: Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN ke number nahi bolega.
blocked.empty: Bhejane ke liye kuch nahi hai.
blocked.too_long: Yeh message bohot bada hai. Kripya ise chhota karein.

otp_request.title: Unhone aapka OTP maanga hai
otp_request.body: Bank kabhi call par OTP nahi maangte. Awaaz is call par OTP ya PIN padhkar nahi sunayega.

pin_request.title: Unhone aapka PIN maanga hai
pin_request.body: Kisi bank ya dukan ko call par aapka PIN nahi chahiye hota. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padhkar nahi sunayega.

upi_pin.title: Unhone aapka UPI PIN maanga hai
upi_pin.body: Aapka UPI PIN sirf aapke liye hai. Awaaz is call par PIN ya code padhkar nahi sunayega.

cvv_request.title: Unhone aapke card ka CVV maanga hai
cvv_request.body: Call par kabhi CVV na batayein. Awaaz is call par card ki details padhkar nahi sunayega.

remote_app.title: Unhone app install karne ko kaha hai
remote_app.body: Kisi ke kehne par kabhi koi app install na karein. Isse woh aapka phone aur bank dekh sakte hain.

other.title: Yeh koi jhoothi scam call ho sakti hai
other.body: Savadhan rahein. Awaaz is call par OTP, PIN ya card ki details padhkar nahi sunayega.

errors.draft_failed: Main yeh nahi bana paya. Dusre shabdon ki koshish karein.
errors.not_available: Bolne mein madad suvidha ke liye live AI service chahiye.
errors.unknown_preview: Ab confirm karne ke liye kuch nahi hai.
errors.not_implemented: Yeh suvidha abhi uplabdh nahi hai.
errors.bad_event: Kuch galti ho gayi. Phir se koshish karein.
